Siege-ladder tips just kissing the parapet edge, first rung scraping stone at the northeast tower before any soldier has yet crested.
Battering ram mid-contact at the gatehouse arch, iron head compressing the oak planking in the first splintering instant.
Catapult stone frozen at apex directly above the inner keep, suspended at maximum height before gravity reclaims it toward the courtyard.
Cavalry cresting the ridge-line above the valley castle, lead horseman silhouetted in full gallop against the dying sun at the hilltop.
Crown lowering through the final inch above the kneeling figure's head on the throne-room dais, fingertips not yet releasing the golden rim.
Dragon mid-dive one full wingspan above the eastern spire, talons splayed open and shadow consuming the entire upper battlement below.
Boiling oil first cascading over the machicolation lip, the liquid arc catching torchlight before reaching the siege-crew pressed against the curtain wall.
Coronation banner first unfurling from the high spire's iron bracket, the leading edge snapping rigid in the gust above the assembled courtyard.
Spell-circle reaching maximum brilliance at the gatehouse threshold, runes scorching full incandescence outward from the central sigil across the flagstones.
First arrow loosed from the southern battlement, the shaft mid-flight at point-blank range over the crowded siege-works below the wall.
Portal iris dilating to full bloom above the great hall floor, the event horizon shimmering at maximum diameter between the two hearthstone pillars.
Spire tilting at thirty degrees past vertical, masonry joints splitting open and the weathervane swinging wildly above the collapsing southeast tower.
Royal procession cresting the final switchback above the valley floor, lead standard-bearer clearing the ridgeline with the castle gate directly ahead below.
Wedding bell-ringer at peak pull, rope stretched to full tension and the great bell mid-swing above the belfry arch over the nave.
First siege-stone mid-impact at the curtain wall's upper course, shatter-ring of displaced mortar exploding outward from the point of contact.
Dragon-fire just licking the corner of the pennant flag above the keep's highest turret, fabric catching at the very tip in the first flame-tongue.
Wave just cresting the seawall's top course, white water hanging at maximum height above the parapet before breaking across the harbor courtyard below.
Messenger reaching the portcullis at full lathered gallop, horse mid-stride in the last stride before the gate, dispatch-roll clutched in the outstretched fist.
Leyline storm-front crossing the spire-line simultaneously at all three towers, lightning threading between the pinnacles at the instant of maximum charge.
Processional banners crossing the main gate threshold together, all seven poles clearing the arch at the same stride above the threshold flagstone.
First horn-blast leaving the parapet trumpeter's bell, the brass mouth-piece still to the lips as sound departs into the valley below the wall.
Fleet rounding the headland into full line-of-sight of the harbor castle, lead vessel's prow breaking into the bay at the outermost visible point.
Siege-tower upper drawbridge mid-fall toward the battlement, the iron-shod ramp descending through its final arc above the parapet crenellation.
Dragon mid-strafe banking hard above the great hall roof, wingtip nearly grazing the ridge-beam at the lowest point of the strafing pass.
Coronation canopy bearers clearing the inner-ward archway together, the golden canopy frame breaching the threshold above the monarch mid-processional step beneath.
